title: Erdős Problem 263 — Lean 4 formalization of the folklore growth criterion for irrationality sequences
description: Machine-verified Lean 4 + Mathlib formalizations for Erdős Problem 263 (erdosproblems.com/263): a complete zero-sorry proof of the growth criterion for irrationality sequences (liminf a_{n+1}/a_n^{2+ε} > 0 implies the reciprocal sum is irrational for every asymptotic perturbation), a supporting lemma package including the irrationality of ∑ 1/2^{2^n}, and a fidelity-audited formal statement of the problem. Q1 remains open. Verification: lake build (Lean 4.32.2, Mathlib v4.32.2), zero sorry outside the declared open obligation. Developed with AI assistance under a machine-verification gate; see README for verification commands and the statement-fidelity audit.
